# DoorStep Diva — Premium At-Home Salon & Bridal Beauty Service

> DoorStep Diva is a certified doorstep salon bringing salon-grade beauty treatments, bridal artistry, hair styling, skin therapies, and nail extensions directly to clients' homes and event venues across Delhi NCR, Lucknow, and Ayodhya.

## Core Value Proposition
- **100% Sealed Single-Use Kits**: Disposable towels, gowns, bedsheets, and wooden spatulas unsealed in front of the client.
- **Hospital-Grade Sterilization**: Metallic instruments are sanitized and sealed.
- **Certified Female Artists**: Background-verified artists equipped with professional equipment.
- **Pay After Service**: No mandatory online deposit for standard appointments; pay via UPI or cash upon satisfactory service delivery.

## Operating Regions & Coverage
- **Delhi NCR**: South Delhi, Central Delhi, West Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Gurgaon (Gurugram), Ghaziabad, and Faridabad.
- **Lucknow**: Gomti Nagar, Hazratganj, Aliganj, Indira Nagar, Mahanagar, Ashiyana, Vikas Nagar, and surrounding localities.
- **Ayodhya**: Ayodhya city, Faizabad township, and wedding venue destinations.

## How to Book
1. Visit [https://mydoorstepdiva.com/book](https://mydoorstepdiva.com/book)
2. Select your city (Delhi NCR, Lucknow, or Ayodhya) and choose your services.
3. Choose your preferred timing (ASAP, Morning, Afternoon, Evening, or Custom Date).
4. Submit your contact details with zero advance fee.
5. A beauty coordinator calls or messages on WhatsApp within 15 minutes to confirm artist assignment.
